heat: Always ensure tools are on the same surface as the object before using them.
Ensure the appliance is activated before attempting to use it for heating, even if closed and containing the target object.
Always ensure the target container is closed before placing or heating items inside.
Check if any object is already hot before attempting to heat it; use existing hot objects when required.
examine: Check if an object is accessible before attempting to take it; ensure proper tool use and object interaction conditions are met.
Ensure the target object is within reach and explicitly visible before attempting to examine it with a tool.
Check if an object is hidden under another by examining the covering object, not just the surface.
clean: Always verify object placement by checking the container's contents after attempting to put an object inside.
Check for necessary resources before attempting a task; if missing, seek alternatives or ways to acquire them.
put: Check if an object can be picked up before attempting to take or move it; verify its interactability first.
Check all relevant containers and surfaces systematically, including shelves, cabinets, and drawers, before concluding an object is missing.
Ensure object is within reach and use correct syntax: "take [object] from [location]" only if object is visible and accessible.
cool: Check if an object is directly interactable before attempting to take it; use examine or context clues to verify.
